issues.description: The problem statement (and the provided solution) define StockIngredient.price as an int (constructor StockIngredient(String, int, int) and getPrice() returning int), but the template's StockIngredient declares price as a double and uses a constructor StockIngredient(String, double, int) with getPrice() returning double. This mismatch will cause students to implement SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice() (which is specified to return int and to add ingredient prices) against a template where StockIngredient.getPrice() returns double — producing type errors or forcing casts. The inconsistency between problem, template, and solution is structural and will block or confuse students implementing the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template match the specification and solution by changing StockIngredient.price from double to int in src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java and update the constructor and getPrice() return type accordingly (StockIngredient(String, int, int); getPrice() returns int). Alternatively, if doubles are intended, update the problem statement and solution to consistently use double for price and adjust method signatures (e.g., calculateTotalPrice) to use/return double.
